Bills of the 118th US Congress as hyperevents

Source: R/data.R
congress_bills_118.Rd

Every House and Senate bill introduced in the 118th Congress (January 2023 to January 2025) as a directed hyperevent: the sponsor sends the bill, the cosponsors receive it. An hyperedge_log() with the bill number and the introduction date; congress_members_118 gives party and state.

Usage

congress_bills_118

Format

An amorem_hyperedge_log with 16,213 rows: I (list of one sponsor bioguide id), J (list of cosponsor bioguide ids, possibly empty), time (days since 3 January 2023), bill (e.g. "hr184"), date (introduced).

Source

US Government Publishing Office, BILLSTATUS bulk data for the 118th Congress, https://www.govinfo.gov/bulkdata/BILLSTATUS, accessed 2026-10-17. A work of the US Government, public domain (17 U.S.C. 105).
